title: Review map: full application design and portable coding context
summary: Historical two-layer map. Use plan-application and plan-coding-context for live semantic records; embedded map snapshots are not current status.
body:
Open project-memory/maps/two-layer-map.html. Data is project-memory/maps/two-layer-plan.json; regenerate with scripts/build_two_layer_map.py. The complete preserved agreement is included and mapped to branches. Canonical schema inventory distinguishes existing typed YAML from missing fine-grained context routes. Original model locks and one-page restrictions are shown as historical. User requested both layers together, including every canonical subcomponent, on 2026-09-25. Browser navigation and no horizontal overflow were checked at desktop and narrow widths. Source preservation does not independently certify interpretation of every summary.
The versioned graph now holds semantic migration. This old map remains a reference; its embedded current_records and incomplete-state wording are historical snapshots.
change_reason: Mark older map as a reference snapshot and route to current graph
